snippet.title: Toyforming - Summer 2022 Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Toyforming is a game that will be available for iOS and Android in which you can toyform your own Earth-like planet with 2D drawings turned into 3D toys!

The smart AI will turn any work of art into a creation that will live on your planet, and you can watch as your creations enjoy their life interacting with their surroundings and having an effect on them! Add the sun and the moon to your world to see it change into daytime and nighttime, and with AR Mode, you can view your planet as it exists in our world—in your room, at the park, or anywhere you go!

Remember: everything lives together in harmony. Plantlife, wildlife, humans, man-made objects, and even the weather will have an impact on your toyformed planet. Throw in clouds to make it rain and fill your planet with water, and add trees and plants to make the world green. Go wild and see what kind of planet you can create and share!

Scheduled for release in early 2023.
